result.title: Finite Interaction Lens: Structured Precision Sharing for Vision-Language Models
result.summary: Identifying which visual interventions interact in a vision-language model requires comparing their joint and separate effects. The resulting four-output difference can be small enough for rounding error to obscure it. We introduce the Finite Interaction Lens (FIL), a mixed-precision method for evaluating finite intervention families. At each selected linear projection, FIL decomposes each candidate's input into a native state, two single-intervention components, and a full-dimensional mixed residual. It projects the single-intervention components at higher precision and reuses the same numerical contributions in the joint candidates, while retaining every mixed residual and nonlinear trajectory. We derive a local cancellation identity and a conditional bound on error propagation through a smooth nonlinearity. In one MLP of Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct, FIL reduces final interaction MSE by 94.4% on 16 synthetic families and by 99.85% and 99.35% in two separate four-image COCO studies, relative to a control that has the same nominal BF16-product budget and higher-precision single interventions but projects each joint candidate independently. One image accounts for most of the absolute gain in each COCO study. Higher-accuracy multi-product BF16 arithmetic on all candidates gives lower aggregate error at similar total query times. Single-product BF16 already recovers the reference choices in both candidate-selection tasks we tested. On these development inputs, FIL improves interaction fidelity at a fixed nominal precision budget. Its practical value depends on a task that needs the extra fidelity.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Finite Interaction Lens（FIL），一种混合精度方法：在选定的线性投影处把每个候选输入分解为原生状态、两个单干预分量与满维混合残差，对单干预分量以更高精度投影并在联合候选中复用同一数值贡献，从而降低「联合效果减单独效果」四输出差分中被舍入误差淹没的部分，并在 Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct 的一个 MLP 上以合成族与 COCO 四图研究验证误差下降。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作不涉及 latent 推理状态或生成机制，但其对干预交互效应（joint 与 separate 之差）的可靠数值估计，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、视觉干预贡献与交互度量的评估做法，属需较多核查的方法线索。
